principles.title: Complexity
principles.description: I enjoy problems where the obvious solution isn't good enough.

principles.title: Performance
principles.description: Optimize where it matters: CPU, memory, I/O, latency and infrastructure cost.

principles.title: Simplicity
principles.description: Clean code isn't about fewer lines. It's about fewer reasons for things to break.

principles.title: Adaptability
principles.description: Different domains, clients, teams and constraints require different engineering decisions.

principles.title: Ownership
principles.description: I don't just implement designs. I challenge them, improve them and take responsibility for the outcome.

principles.title: Pressure
principles.description: Production incidents, hard deadlines and ambiguous requirements are part of engineering.
